## 4. Flagship Engineering Systems & Architecture

### 1. Healios V2 — Multimodal Post-Operative Wound Recovery Platform
- **Problem Solved:** Postoperative surgical site infections (SSIs) drive up to 20% of unplanned 30-day hospital readmissions. Remote monitoring apps suffer from low clinical trust due to opaque black-box deep learning scores and poor-quality phone captures.
- **Technical Architecture:**
  - **Explainable AI (XAI):** Vectorized NumPy Grad-CAM implementation computing gradient heatmaps via piecewise linear interpolation in **8.09ms** without matplotlib GUI locks.
  - **Tissue Morphology:** HSV color-space segmentation calculating granulation, slough, and necrotic bed percentages in **2.00ms**.
  - **Edge Quality Gate:** In-browser HTML5 Canvas 3x3 Laplacian convolution kernel verifying focus and sharpness in **<35ms** before upload.
  - **Stereoscopic 3D Depth:** Mobile iOS ARKit TrueDepth point-cloud mesh calculation with **±0.08mm** elevation margin.
  - **Clinical Tooling:** In-memory BM25 surgical guideline RAG retrieving Enhanced Recovery After Surgery (ERAS) handbooks in **0.14ms**.
  - **Total Latency:** **<42ms** end-to-end pipeline latency.
- **Repository:** https://github.com/haresham15/HealiosPostSurgery

### 2. Apexis — Centralized Motorsports Intelligence & Telemetry Engine
- **Problem Solved:** Fragmented multi-series motorsport telemetry across Formula 1, F2, F3, FE, and NASCAR.
- **Technical Architecture:**
  - **Off-Main-Thread Physics Worker:** Multi-threaded Web Worker (`simulator.worker.ts`) computing multi-car coordinates, sector split times, and tire wear curves at a deterministic **60 FPS** with zero UI jank.
  - **In-Browser OCR:** Client-side Tesseract.js worker extracting broadcast standings and interval deltas directly from live video canvas snapshots without cloud server costs.
  - **Historical Telemetry Database:** Indexed local SQLite database executing queries across 70+ years of Formula 1 telemetry in **<12ms**.
- **Repository:** https://github.com/haresham15/AIMotorsportsHub

### 3. Tempo — RSD Communication Buffer & Regulation Suite
- **Problem Solved:** Communication impulsivity and executive dysfunction in high-stimulation professional settings.
- **Technical Architecture:**
  - **Deterministic Gate:** 0.2ms pre-flight regex interception circuit evaluating emotional volatility before network dispatch.
  - **Vector Memory:** PostgreSQL pgvector IVFFlat Cosine similarity indexing retrieving emotional grounding strategies with **100% (5/5) crisis recall**.
  - **Failover Buffer:** Dual LLM active-passive failover with strict Zod schema validation ensuring zero un-routed external packet leakage.
- **Repository:** https://github.com/haresham15/TempoADHDAssist

### 4. Careline / RouteRx — Multi-Modal Healthcare Transit Hub (1st Place ASA DataFest)
- **Problem Solved:** Non-emergency medical transportation (NEMT) access deserts causing missed chemotherapy, dialysis, and prenatal appointments.
- **Technical Architecture:**
  - **Routing Engine:** Open Source Routing Machine (OSRM) instance executing multi-modal isochrone queries in **<15ms**.
  - **Vulnerability Index:** Integrated census tract demographic matrices with public bus transit route GTFS data to pinpoint transit-isolated high-acuity patient clusters.
- **Repository:** https://github.com/haresham15/Careline
